{{< video https://www.youtube.com/embed/9cqHAgnub_M >}}

This song is the closer on [_Sonic Highways_](https://open.spotify.com/album/2qwN15acAl3sm3Idce5vK9?si=Lr-lcBEwRjiLklNYgCoseg), one of my favorite albums. It's basically perfect--the build-up and powerful ending. It has the same energy/feel as [_Wheels_](https://open.spotify.com/track/3KsatAMRt1a7iryhWt5I8U?si=ed8e5ebb874b4199), which is among my favorite songs of all-time (and also on this list [here](https://inthedetails.zajichekstats.com/posts/wheels/)). Strangely, I'm not actually that into [Foo Fighters](https://open.spotify.com/artist/7jy3rLJdDQY21OgRLCZ9sD?si=xmewG9snQuOgJ-ivR7UrXA). This album (+ _Wheels_) are really the only stuff of theirs I can get hooked on. [_My Hero_](https://open.spotify.com/track/4dVbhS6OiYvFikshyaQaCN?si=e07fe4c1806340b2) and some of their other hits are decent but I don't go out of my way to listen.
